description: This file provides centralized configuration and environment variable handling for a React frontend, including functions for reading environment variables, parsing JSON and boolean values, normalizing URLs, and constructing API URLs based on environment settings.

methods.name: readEnv(key, fallback)
methods.description: Reads an environment variable by key, with optional fallback, returning trimmed string or undefined.

methods.name: readEnvJson(key, fallback)
methods.description: Parses a JSON environment variable value, with fallback on parse error.

methods.name: readEnvBool(key, fallback)
methods.description: Parses a boolean environment variable value, supporting various true/false representations, with fallback.

methods.name: normalizeBaseUrl(url)
methods.description: Normalizes URLs by removing trailing slashes, handles invalid URLs gracefully.

methods.name: isFeatureEnabled(flagName)
methods.description: Checks if a feature flag is enabled based on environment configuration.

methods.name: joinUrl(base, path)
methods.description: Concatenates a base URL and a path, ensuring proper slashes.

methods.name: buildApiUrl(path)
methods.description: Builds a full API URL based on environment configuration, falling back to relative URL if necessary.
